## Checklist for new entries

- [ ] The project is not already listed (I searched the README and `data/catalogue.json`).
- [ ] The source repository URL is the canonical upstream, not a fork or mirror.
- [ ] The project has an open-source license (I checked the repo's license file).
- [ ] I have added the entry to the correct section in `README.md`.
- [ ] I have added the entry to `data/catalogue.json` in alphabetical order within its category.
- [ ] The description is one short, neutral, original sentence — not copied from another list or the project's own README.
- [ ] If this is an asset-dependent reimplementation or source port, I have noted that original game data may be required.
- [ ] I have run `python3 scripts/validate_catalogue.py` locally with no errors.
